name: cavemio-command-palette
title: Command Palette
description: Search commands from a compact keyboard shortcut trigger with fuzzy matching, nested actions, and a moving result highlight.

cavemio.usage:
import { CommandPalette } from "@/components/command-palette";

<CommandPalette items={[{ id: "home", label: "Home", href: "/" }]} />
cavemio.accessibility: Modal dialog with combobox/listbox semantics, keyboard navigation, focus return, inert background, and live reduced motion. Commands receive an abort signal; stale completions cannot close a new session.
cavemio.previewNote: Demo commands run locally; callers supply items and navigation callbacks.

props.name: items
props.description: Required. Commands and groups available in the palette.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Optional. Placeholder shown in the search field.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Optional. Accessible name of the search field.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Optional. The letter that opens it with ⌘ (or Ctrl). Empty string turns the hotkey off.

props.name: open
props.description: Optional. Controlled open state of the palette.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Optional. Initial open state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Optional. Called when the palette opens or closes.

props.name: showTrigger
props.description: Optional. Show the command menu trigger. Without it, open with the hotkey or the open prop.

props.name: triggerIcon
props.description: Optional. Leading trigger icon. Defaults to search; pass null to omit it.

props.name: filters
props.description: Optional. Caller-owned active search scopes. The caller also filters items.

props.name: filtersLabel
props.description: Optional. Accessible name for the active search filters.

props.name: onFilterRemove
props.description: Optional. Called with the ID of a removed filter.

props.name: footer
props.description: Optional. Help copy, links, or actions alongside the keyboard hints.
